summary: Stirling-PDF is a self-hosted web application designed for processing PDF documents. It provides an interface for common document workflows including merging, splitting, file conversions and optical character recognition.
goodFor: It is well-suited for users who need a centralised tool for document manipulation without relying on external cloud-based services.
watchOut: The resource footprint of a Java-based web application can be heavier than native alternatives, requiring adequate memory allocation on your server.
deployNotes: Deployment is typically handled via Docker, requiring persistent storage volumes for temporary file processing and a reverse proxy to manage HTTPS.
